commitments.detail: The portable ultrasound cart will be assigned to the intensive care unit for Monday morning use.
The vascular access service will have access to the cart in the central equipment room if needed.
The cart will be charged and ready for use at the start of Monday morning.
A probe cover will be used during the cart's use to protect the equipment.
Post-use disinfection of the cart will be performed to ensure proper sanitation.
